card.name: Identify or recognize a condition early
card.fires_on: The verbs "recognized", "recognize" or "Identify" when the text is about spotting a syndrome or adverse reaction. Most often in "if not recognized and treated" and at the start of a CRS instruction.

modes.label: Not recognized and treated
modes.description: "recognized" after "if not" in warnings that a condition may become life-threatening.
modes.example: Meningococcal infection may become rapidly life-threatening or fatal if not<< recognized>> and treated early.

modes.label: Identify at start of instruction
modes.description: "Identify" opening a sentence right after a syndrome heading.
modes.example: Cytokine Release Syndrome (CRS)<< Identify>> CRS based on clinical presentation

modes.label: Hard to recognize
modes.description: "recognize" after "more difficult to" when signs are masked.
modes.example: making it more difficult to<< recognize>> See full prescribing information

card.writes: It seems to push toward word pieces that continue a detection verb, and away from words like flaws and defects.
card.plain: It fires on words meaning to spot or identify a condition, like "recognized" in "if not recognized and treated".
